mentions.name: Volt-Test
mentions.description: This is a performance testing engine that brings k6-style load testing to the PHP ecosystem. It comprises a Go-based load-testing engine and a PHP SDK that lets developers write performance tests inside PHPUnit, with assertions for latency, error rates, and business logic. It can spin up local servers and run in CI/CD, is gaining distributed mode to scale tests across multiple nodes, and a cloud version is in development so teams can run large tests without managing infrastructure.
mentions.problem: Repeatedly debugging concurrency and race-condition issues in Laravel/PHP applications, with no k6-like load-testing tool in the PHP ecosystem
mentions.audience: Laravel and PHP developers writing performance/load tests
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on Volt-Test, a performance testing engine I started building after repeatedly debugging concurrency and race-condition issues in Laravel/PHP applications.

The idea is to bring something like k6 to the PHP ecosystem:

A Go-based load-testing engine

A PHP SDK that lets developers write performance tests inside PHPUnit

Assertions for latency, error rates, and business logic

Can spin up local servers and run in CI/CD

Working on distributed mode to scale tests across multiple nodes

Currently building the cloud version so teams can run large tests without managing infrastructure
